WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.logregistry, r.arcref,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
         r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration r JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, res / (acc * SQRT(1 + err / acc)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id,
       acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm,
       ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
       CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
            WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
            ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS registration_confidence_level
FROM x
ORDER BY rar DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * POWER((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res_mm,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom_acc
  FROM mesh
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
         COUNT(m.zoneref) AS total_meshes,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res_mm < 1.0 AND m.geom_acc < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
         AVG(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(m.res_mm) AS avg_res, AVG(m.geom_acc) AS avg_geom
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN hf_meshes * 100.0 / total_meshes ELSE 0 END, 2) AS hf_percentage,
       ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geom, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
       CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality' ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM agg
ORDER BY hf_percentage DESC, site_code

WITH per AS (
  SELECT p.equipref,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         ((p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric * ((p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric + (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric) / 2)
         / NULLIF(REPLACE(s.size, ' GB', '')::numeric * 10 * LOG(10, (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric + 10000), 0) AS pru
  FROM processing p
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = p.zoneref AND m.equipref = p.equipref
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
), eq AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry, AVG(per.pru) AS pru, AVG(per.hrs) AS hrs, AVG(per.cpu) AS cpu, AVG(per.gpu) AS gpu
  FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN per ON per.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id,
       ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru,
       ROUND(hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC) AS efficiency_rank,
       CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
       jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM eq
ORDER BY pru ASC

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::float8 AS pdens,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 AS cov,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8 AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float8 AS noise,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 AS acc,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8 AS err
  FROM scans s
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref
), pcm AS (
  SELECT zoneref, res, noise, err,
         cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100)) AS sce,
         LOG(res * 1000) / LOG(pdens) * 5 AS sri,
         res / (acc * SQRT(1 + err/acc)) AS rar
  FROM pc
), me AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8 / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 * POWER((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
         (mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::float8 / (SQRT((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8) * (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8) * 0.01 AS tdi,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float8 AS geom
  FROM mesh
), rows AS (
  SELECT pcm.zoneref, pcm.sce, pcm.rar, pcm.err, pcm.res, pcm.noise,
         POWER(10 / pcm.sri, 1.5) * (pcm.sce / 100) * POWER(1 - pcm.noise / 30, 2) AS sqs,
         me.mcr * (me.tdi / 10) * (1 + EXP(-me.geom)) AS mfs
  FROM pcm JOIN me ON me.zoneref = pcm.zoneref
), d AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         0.3 * (0.4 * sqs + 0.4 * mfs + 0.2 * sce - 5 * SQRT(noise / 10))
         + 0.3 * mfs + 0.2 * rar + 0.2 * sce - 2 * SQRT(err / res) AS dpq
  FROM rows
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(d.dpq)::numeric, 2) AS dpq
FROM sites st JOIN d ON d.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY dpq DESC

SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name,
       c.structstate AS structural_state,
       st.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
       CASE WHEN (st.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' ILIKE '%Poor%' OR st.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' ILIKE '%Critical%')
                 AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
            THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites st JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = st.zoneregistry

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::float8 AS pdens,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 AS cov,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8 AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float8 AS noise
  FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), q AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         POWER(10 / (LOG(res * 1000) / LOG(pdens) * 5), 1.5)
         * (cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) / 100)
         * POWER(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs
  FROM pc
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(q.sqs)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM sites st JOIN q ON q.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH pr AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.flowsoft, '.', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('agi', 'agisoft', 'agisoftmetashape', 'metashape') THEN 'Agisoft'
           WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.flowsoft, '.', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('cc', 'cloudcompare') THEN 'CloudCompare'
           WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.flowsoft, '.', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('geo', 'geomagic', 'geomagicstudio') THEN 'Geomagic'
           WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.flowsoft, '.', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('rc', 'realitycapture') THEN 'RealityCapture'
           ELSE p.flowsoft END AS software,
         p.flowstage AS stage, p.flowregistry,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::float8 AS hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::float8 AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::float8 AS gpu,
         REPLACE(s.size, ' GB', '')::float8 AS size_gb,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::float8 AS pts
  FROM processing p
  JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
), per AS (
  SELECT *, size_gb * LOG(pts) / NULLIF(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200, 0) AS per_val FROM pr
), g AS (
  SELECT software, stage, AVG(hrs) AS hrs, AVG(cpu) AS cpu, AVG(gpu) AS gpu, AVG(size_gb) AS size_gb, AVG(per_val) AS per_val, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS n
  FROM per GROUP BY software, stage
)
SELECT software, stage,
       ROUND(hrs::numeric, 1) AS avg_processing_hours,
       ROUND(cpu::numeric, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage,
       ROUND(gpu::numeric, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage,
       ROUND(size_gb::numeric, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb,
       ROUND(per_val::numeric, 1) AS avg_per,
       CASE WHEN per_val < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
       n AS workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY CASE WHEN per_val < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, per_val ASC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT st.zoneregistry,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::float8 / NULLIF((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::float8 * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::float8, 0) AS pcdr,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::float8 AS cdens,
         (f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::float8 + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::float8 AS feats
  FROM sites st
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code,
       ROUND(AVG(pcdr)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pcdr,
       ROUND(AVG(feats / NULLIF(pcdr * SQRT(cdens), 0) * 1000)::numeric, 2) AS avg_fee
FROM b
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::float8 AS temp,
         (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::float8 AS hum,
         (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::float8 AS lux
  FROM environment
), s AS (
  SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel,
         AVG(e.temp) AS temp, AVG(e.hum) AS hum, AVG(e.lux) AS lux,
         AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS(e.temp - 20) - POWER(ABS((e.hum - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / (e.lux + 100)) AS esi
  FROM sites st JOIN e ON e.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(temp::numeric, 1) AS avg_temperature,
       ROUND(hum::numeric, 1) AS avg_humidity,
       ROUND(lux::numeric, 1) AS avg_illumination,
       ROUND(esi::numeric, 1) AS avg_esi,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY esi) AS esi_quartile,
       CASE WHEN esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS eccs_classification
FROM s
ORDER BY esi DESC

SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::float8 - 20)
                 - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::float8 - 50) / 2), 1.5)
                 - 600 / ((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::float8 + 100))::numeric, 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites st JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC
